_comment: Single source of truth for the DevPT app catalog. The footer list is rendered from this file by app.js. Apps with placement 'plate' must have a visible id="app-<id>" surface in index.html that links to the app URL. placement values: 'hero' | 'nav' | 'plate' | 'footer'.

apps.name: simLAB
apps.blurb: An integrated clinical simulation workspace with native DDx cases, patient and instructor conversations, examination, documentation, debrief, and live classes.

apps.name: Movement lab
apps.blurb: Explore clinical tests and joint movements on simLAB's 3D patient, with adjustable findings.
apps.note: Native simLAB learning tool; access follows simLAB sign-in and account approval.

apps.name: Neuro lab
apps.blurb: Explore sensory pathways and lesion effects alongside the bedside examination and 3D anatomy.
apps.note: Native simLAB learning tool; access follows simLAB sign-in and account approval.

apps.name: Aquatic Therapy
apps.blurb: Explore immersion, movement, and physiologic response in simLAB.
apps.note: Native simLAB learning tool. The standalone simVITALS source application remains available at https://aquatic.devpt.app.

apps.name: Live Vitals
apps.blurb: Follow posture, effort, and recovery with model-derived vital signs.
apps.note: Native simLAB learning tool; access follows simLAB sign-in and account approval.

apps.name: PainMap
apps.blurb: Development and validation work for 3D symptom mapping beyond the 0-10 scale.
apps.note: www.3dpain.app is the canonical URL. The `www.` is required: the bare 3dpain.app apex has no DNS address record and does not resolve, and .app is HSTS-preloaded so it fails unbypassably rather than warning. pain3d.com is the retired brand domain, kept as an alias because it 301s to the canonical host. The previously-listed pain.devpt.app alias was never provisioned and has been dropped. See 3DPainMap/docs/access-and-domains.md.

apps.name: simMOVE
apps.blurb: Pose a 3D model and read each joint against its normative range of motion.

unlisted.name: simNOTE
unlisted.blurb: Documentation that behaves like a real chart.
unlisted.note: Legacy standalone documentation tool retained in the portfolio registry; the homepage now leads with documentation inside simLAB.

unlisted.name: simCHAT
unlisted.blurb: A virtual patient to interview, on demand.
unlisted.note: Standalone virtual patient tool retained in the portfolio registry; the homepage now leads with patient conversations inside simLAB.

unlisted.name: PT Rapid Recall
unlisted.note: Onboarding into DevPT/Education (2026-07-01). Data-safety hazard RESOLVED: the deploy workflow now uses `prisma migrate deploy` (committed migration 20260126_init_postgresql; no --accept-data-loss; DB mutates only on push to the default branch, never on PRs). Remaining before public promotion: a stable devpt.app subdomain (currently only a raw Azure SWA host).

engines.role: Branching clinical-scenario engine; consumed by simlab as a git submodule.
Shared 3D rig/pose library; consumed by 3DPainMap, simpacs, simvitals. Currently also the de-facto source of the runtime mannequin GLBs.
Intended canonical mannequin GLB assets — currently UNCONSUMED (apps copy GLBs from pose-engine/models instead). Resolve the source of truth.
